info.title: StreamMii
info.author: Funtum
info.description: Stream your Wii U to another device.
info.details:
An Aroma plugin that streams your Wii U's TV or GamePad display to another device.

StreamMii uses configurable LZ4 or JPEG compression to capture and stream your display over the local network. A Python receiver application is required and runs on a computer.

Things to note:
- Streaming performance and frame rates are limited by the Wii U's hardware.
- Encoding is performed in software and may cause slowdowns.
- Some applications and applets, such as Miiverse, cannot be streamed.
- Some applications may produce different colors in the stream.
- If you experience performance issues, try lowering the capture resolution or disabling the plugin.

More information can be found in the plugin's repository.
